name: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike
summary: Bengaluru's city corporation, which owns and maintains the city's roads, including the Outer Ring Road.
ownership: Government of Karnataka — urban local body
about: BBMP was formed in 2007 by merging the old Bangalore city corporation with the surrounding municipal councils, which is how a city that had grown far past its old limits came under one authority. It maintains Bengaluru's roads, drains and footpaths, and it is the body people complain to about a pothole. Its road network includes the Outer Ring Road, the corridor along which most of the city's technology parks were built.
facts: Formed in 2007 by merging Bengaluru's city corporation with seven surrounding municipal councils.
Maintains the Outer Ring Road, the spine of Bengaluru's technology corridor.
Responsible for city roads, storm-water drains and footpaths.
One of the largest municipal corporations in India by area and budget.

grievance.note: The corporation's site carries its public grievance and civic complaint channels.
